edges.reason: msg.sender is the depositor whose balance is checked and who receives minted aTokens.
msg.sender is passed to calculateUserGlobalData, calculateLoanOriginationFee and updateStateOnBorrow.
msg.sender is the repayer and is checked against _onBehalfOf.
msg.sender reaches redeemUnderlying through the aToken and is restricted by onlyOverlyingAToken.
any caller can trigger a flashloan with an arbitrary receiver.
msg.sender becomes the liquidator and receives seized collateral.

onlyLendingPool modifier gates the fee transfer function.

msg.sender is the ERC20 transfer sender.

linear interest depends on block.timestamp minus the last update timestamp.

reserve.lastUpdateTimestamp is set to block.timestamp after a rate refresh.

transferFrom performs the balance move first.

transfer performs the balance move.

decreaseAllowance rewrites the allowance.

the borrower parameter selects the position being liquidated.

the receive-aToken flag branches between aToken transfer and burn+transfer.
the receiver parameter is cast and called back by flashLoan.
the params blob is forwarded verbatim to the receiver callback.

userIndexReset selects the index value emitted in the Redeem event.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _reserve only feeds LendingPool.deposit lookups and can be folded into the deposit function node.
Parameter _amount is only meaningful as the quantity handled by LendingPool.deposit.
Parameter _referralCode is only used for the Deposit event emitted by LendingPool.deposit.
Local healthFactorBelowThreshold exists only to gate LendingPool.borrow and merges into it.
Parameter _user identifies the position processed by the liquidation manager entry point.
Parameter _purchaseAmount is consumed only inside the liquidation computation.
Parameter _receiveAToken only selects a branch inside the liquidation logic.
Parameter _receiver is only an argument of the flashloan callback orchestration.
Parameter _params is forwarded verbatim by the flashloan function.
Local fromBalance is a working value of executeTransferInternal.
Local userIndexReset exists only to choose the emitted index in AToken.redeem.
Parameter _to is the redirection target handled by redirectInterestStream.
Local currentRedirectionAddress is a temporary read inside the redirection logic.
Parameter _newImplementation is the address stored by upgradeToAndCall.
Parameter data is the payload delegatecalled by upgradeToAndCall.
Parameter newAdmin is written to the admin slot by changeAdmin.
Local localCounter is the mutex snapshot consumed by the nonReentrant modifier.
Local balanceIncrease is the accrued interest produced by cumulateBalanceInternal.
Parameter _logic is the implementation address consumed by proxy initialize.
The LiquidationCallLocalVars struct is the scratch space of the liquidation entry point.
